description: This file implements the AVInput plugin for the WPEFramework, including plugin registration, method registration, event handling, plugin activation, and communication with Thunder services. It manages HDMI input states, device events, and plugin lifecycle.

classes.name: AVInput
classes.description: Main plugin class managing AV input states, plugin lifecycle, event subscriptions, and Thunder RPC communication.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, activates subscription, and starts reconnection timer.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as JSON string.

methods.name: numberOfInputsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving number of HDMI inputs.

methods.name: currentVideoModeWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving current video mode.

methods.name: onAVInputActive
methods.description: Event handler for AV input activation.

methods.name: onAVInputInactive
methods.description: Event handler for AV input deactivation.

methods.name: numberOfInputs
methods.description: Internal method to get number of HDMI inputs.

methods.name: currentVideoMode
methods.description: Internal method to get current video mode.

methods.name: contentProtected
methods.description: Returns content protection status (hardcoded as true).

methods.name: getThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates or returns a Thunder RPC client for plugin communication.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a plugin by call sign via Thunder RPC.

methods.name: isPluginActivated
methods.description: Checks if a plugin is activated via Thunder RPC.

methods.name: getActivatedPluginReady
methods.description: Waits for plugin to warm up after activation.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to device change events via Thunder RPC.

methods.name: onDevicesChangedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles device change events, triggers active/inactive events.

methods.name: onTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to attempt subscription if not already subscribed.
